messages:
secops-bot: ALERT: anomalous KMS Decrypt activity detected for key projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/customer/cryptoKeys/kr-ml-prod. Count=42, unique_ips=35, principal=infra-deployer@redwood-prod, rule=kms-unusual-decrypt
Maria Chen: putting oncall war-room. tagging @Ajay Patel @Sarah Li @Priya Rao
Ajay Patel: pulling audit logs now. can someone grab the CI runner list?
Sarah Li: I've paused affected deployments in prod and posted a short note to #product-alerts: 'deployments paused, investigating security event'
Ajay Patel: log snippet:
```
protoPayload.methodName="google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.Decrypt"
protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail="infra-deployer@redwood-prod"
resource.name="projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/customer/cryptoKeys/kr-ml-prod/cryptoKeyVersions/1"
```
sourceIps: 18.205.33.18, 35.196.4.12, 52.12.22.7
Ajay Patel: CI job deployer-runner-2 showed terraform apply at 02:11 UTC using that SA token. token TTL ~12h
Maria Chen: containment plan: 1) disable infra-deployer SA keys 2) block offending IP ranges in firewall 3) rotate CMK (keep old version sealed as evidence) 4) snapshot audit logs to secure bucket. Assigning roles: Ajay -> logs & evidence, Priya -> KMS rotation, Jon -> IAM lockdown, Sarah -> comms & ticketing
Priya Rao: starting rotation. Will create new key version, disable old version, and export audit-only snapshot to GCS (no key material export). Creating bucket gs://sec-evidence-2026
Jon Ortega: applying immediate IAM hardening: disabling SA and removing iam.serviceAccountUser bindings. commands:
```
gcloud iam service-accounts disable infra-deployer@redwood-prod
gcloud projects remove-iam-policy-binding redwood-prod --member=\"serviceAccount:infra-deployer@redwood-prod\" --role=\"roles/iam.serviceAccountUser\"
```
Jon Ortega: done: SA disabled. note: this will break CI jobs; we've queued a rollback for non-critical pipelines
Maria Chen: Priya — confirm rotation steps and keep old version sealed (no decrypt allowed). Also snapshot logs and preserve integrity (hash).
Priya Rao: rotation in progress. created new version 2 for kr-ml-prod, set default to v2 after verification, disabled v1. exporting logs to gs://sec-evidence-2026/1835001234/log-export.ndjson
Ajay Patel: evidence collected and hashed: GCS path + sha256 7f3b2a... saved to ticket. I've also pulled agent metadata from runners for forensic imaging
Sarah Li: opened incident INC-20260320-42 in PagerDuty and security ticket SEC-4821. Drafting customer comms: short safe statement, legal looped in for review.
Maria Chen: post-containment checklist: 1) full IAM access review across org 2) extend KMS audit retention to 1y 3) add anomaly rule for cross-region decrypt spikes 4) create pre-deploy gate for terraform that prevents SA use for KMS decrypt in prod without human review
Jon Ortega: creating playbook PR to eng-oncall repo with exact commands + rollback guidance
secops-bot: follow-up task SEC-4821-followup created and assigned to Jon Ortega, due 2026-04-03
Sarah Li: Handoff to next on-call Ethan Kim at 08:00 UTC. Summary for handoff: containment completed, SA disabled, CMK rotated, evidence archived to gs://sec-evidence-2026, legal + support notified. Forensics next steps required.
Ethan Kim: ACK — I'll pick this up at 08:00 UTC and continue forensics + customer comms. please add any additional notes here. :thumbsup:
Maria Chen: timeline notes for ticket: 1835001234 initial alert, 1835001280 SA disabled, 1835001500 key v2 created & v1 disabled, 1835001800 evidence export complete
Maria Chen: adding retrospective items to SEC-4821-followup: improve least-privilege for CI runners, rotate long-lived tokens, tighten KMS alert thresholds
